title: Enterprise Data Inventory v1 — Rig Relay (Patched: four-category telemetry/evidence model)
patch_description: Patched to distinguish four categories: product telemetry (first-party, default-on, opt-out), remote telemetry contribution (settings-controlled, consent-gated, default-off), local operational observability (mandatory for governed operation), and enterprise audit/evidence substrate (mandatory in enterprise mode). Fields may_enter_telemetry replaced with may_enter_product_telemetry and may_enter_remote_telemetry_contribution. Added opt_out_behavior and evidence_continuity_requirement fields.

data_classes.description: User-supplied mission instructions and chat messages sent to LLM providers.
data_classes.storage_location: In-memory during session; session artifacts under ~/.rig/relay/sessions/
data_classes.retention_requirement: Session retention only. Must be excluded from all telemetry and exports.
data_classes.export_requirement: Must never be exported. Explicit opt-in required for any sharing.
data_classes.opt_out_behavior: Not affected. Raw prompts are never in any telemetry or evidence layer regardless of opt-in/opt-out state.
data_classes.evidence_continuity_requirement: Not applicable. Raw prompts are not evidence records.
data_classes.procurement_disclosure: Disclose: prompts are sent to configured LLM providers. Not stored in product telemetry, remote telemetry contribution, local operational observability, or enterprise audit/evidence. Not shared.
data_classes.current_protection: Classified as locally-retained in usage data doctrine. Excluded from all derived datasets. Content-light doctrine prohibits raw text in exports.
data_classes.gap: No automated enforcement that prompts never enter export paths beyond redaction validator.

data_classes.description: Model-generated text responses, including code suggestions, analysis, and natural language output.
data_classes.retention_requirement: Session retention only. Must be excluded from all telemetry and exports.
data_classes.export_requirement: Must never be exported. Explicit opt-in required.
data_classes.opt_out_behavior: Not affected. Completions are never in any telemetry or evidence layer.
data_classes.procurement_disclosure: Disclose: completions stored locally only. Not in product telemetry, remote contribution, operational observability, or enterprise evidence. Not shared.
data_classes.current_protection: Classified as locally-retained. Excluded from derived datasets.
data_classes.gap: No automated scan on all emission paths.

data_classes.description: Arguments passed by the LLM to tools (bash commands, file paths, search queries).
data_classes.retention_requirement: Raw arguments locally retained. SHA256 hashes may be retained in local operational observability.
data_classes.export_requirement: Hashed only in derived datasets. Raw never exported.
data_classes.opt_out_behavior: Hashed tool_input_sha256 remains in local operational observability regardless of product-telemetry state. Raw arguments are locally retained only.
data_classes.evidence_continuity_requirement: SHA256 hashes are part of local operational observability evidence.
data_classes.procurement_disclosure: Disclose: tool inputs stored locally as SHA256 hashes in local operational observability. Raw arguments never in product telemetry or remote contribution.
data_classes.current_protection: tool_input_sha256 used in observability. Raw arguments locally retained.
data_classes.gap: No validation that raw arguments never appear in telemetry payloads.

data_classes.description: Command output from bash and other tools, including file contents read by agents.
data_classes.retention_requirement: Session retention only. Must be excluded from all telemetry and exports.
data_classes.export_requirement: Must never be exported.
data_classes.opt_out_behavior: Not affected. Tool results are never in any telemetry or evidence layer.
data_classes.procurement_disclosure: Disclose: tool outputs (stdout/stderr) stored locally. Not in product telemetry, remote contribution, operational observability, or enterprise evidence. Not shared.
data_classes.current_protection: Classified locally-retained. Environment scrubbing strips 28 sensitive vars before subprocess.
data_classes.gap: No post-hoc scan of tool results for accidental secret emission.

data_classes.description: Git repo topology, branch names, commit hashes, dirty state, file paths (relative).
data_classes.retention_requirement: Path hashes may be evidence-retained. Raw paths locally retained.
data_classes.export_requirement: Salted path hashes only in exports.
data_classes.opt_out_behavior: Repo state SHA256 remains in local operational observability. Raw paths are locally retained only.
data_classes.evidence_continuity_requirement: SHA256 hashes are part of local operational observability evidence.
data_classes.procurement_disclosure: Disclose: repo topology and relative paths used locally. Salted hashes only in exports.
data_classes.current_protection: repo_state_sha256 in observability. Path hashes normalized.
data_classes.gap: Relative paths may still reveal proprietary codebase structure.

data_classes.description: Actual file contents read by agents via read_file, context assembly, or bash operations.
data_classes.storage_location: In-memory; context assembly artifacts; tool result artifacts
data_classes.retention_requirement: Session retention only. Must never enter product telemetry, remote contribution, operational observability, or enterprise evidence.
data_classes.export_requirement: Must never be exported.
data_classes.opt_out_behavior: Not affected. Source code is never in any telemetry or evidence layer.
data_classes.procurement_disclosure: Disclose: file contents read locally by tools. Not stored in any telemetry or evidence layer. Not shared.
data_classes.current_protection: Content-light doctrine prohibits raw file contents in telemetry. Binary rejection. Text file size cap (10 MB).
data_classes.gap: No automated scan verifying file contents never leak into trace events.

data_classes.description: Absolute filesystem paths on user's machine, including home directory paths.
data_classes.retention_requirement: Absolute paths must be replaced with relative paths in all persisted artifacts.
data_classes.export_requirement: Must never be exported. Home directory paths must be redacted.
data_classes.opt_out_behavior: Not affected. Absolute paths are never in any telemetry or evidence layer.
data_classes.procurement_disclosure: Disclose: only workspace-relative paths used in artifacts. Home dir paths redacted.
data_classes.current_protection: Context renderer redacts absolute home paths. Static docs escape local paths.
data_classes.gap: No automated scan of all artifacts for absolute path leakage.

data_classes.description: API keys, OAuth tokens, environment variables, provider credentials.
data_classes.retention_requirement: Never stored in plaintext in repo or config files (except .env). OS-native storage preferred.
data_classes.export_requirement: Must never be exported. Token presence may be noted (present/absent) but value never revealed.
data_classes.opt_out_behavior: Not affected. Credentials are never in any telemetry or evidence layer regardless of product-telemetry or remote-contribution state.
data_classes.procurement_disclosure: Disclose: credentials stored locally using OS keychain or .env file. Never in product telemetry, remote contribution, operational observability, enterprise evidence, traces, or exports.
data_classes.current_protection: Environment scrubbing (28 vars). Token redaction in traces. No token in URLs. Sensitive path blocking.
data_classes.gap: No automated token scanning across all persisted files.

data_classes.description: LLM provider API keys and OAuth tokens for DeepSeek, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, OpenRouter.
data_classes.retention_requirement: Never logged. Never in any telemetry layer. Never in exports.
data_classes.export_requirement: Must never be exported.
data_classes.opt_out_behavior: Not affected. Provider tokens are never in any telemetry or evidence layer.
data_classes.procurement_disclosure: Disclose: API keys stored locally. Sent to respective provider APIs for inference. Never shared with Rig Relay maintainers. Never in product telemetry, remote contribution, operational observability, or enterprise evidence.
data_classes.current_protection: ProviderKeyStore with OS-native backends. Token redaction doctrine. Sensitive path blocking prevents reading identity/token files via bash.
data_classes.gap: No key rotation support. No key usage audit.

data_classes.description: OAuth access tokens, refresh tokens, consent records for GitHub and Google identity providers.
data_classes.canonical_format: JSON (encrypted via OS keychain or at-rest)
data_classes.retention_requirement: Stored for session duration. Refresh tokens persisted for re-auth. Must be revocable.
data_classes.export_requirement: Must never be exported.
data_classes.opt_out_behavior: Not affected. OAuth material is never in any telemetry or evidence layer.
data_classes.procurement_disclosure: Disclose: OAuth tokens stored locally. Used for GitHub/Google integration. Never shared. Never in product telemetry, remote contribution, operational observability, or enterprise evidence.
data_classes.current_protection: Token store with encryption preference. Consent store separates consent from tokens. Step-up authorization required for sensitive actions.
data_classes.gap: No token revocation workflow documented. No token usage audit trail.

data_classes.description: First-party content-light telemetry: tool call completions, session lifecycle, state changes, refusals, model observations. SHA256 hashes only for content-derived values. Enabled by default, opt-out. Used for product improvement, adaptive behavior, UX optimization, agent-tool optimization, Ralph/orchestrator/subagent refinement, and derived/aggregate intelligence.
data_classes.retention_requirement: Raw: 3 days default. Derived datasets: 180 days. Cold rollups: 365 days.
data_classes.export_requirement: Exportable only as aggregate/de-identified/derived product intelligence. Requires explicit consent scope for remote contribution.
data_classes.opt_out_behavior: Opt-out disables collection of product telemetry events. Visibly degrades adaptive recommendations, UX optimization, agent-tool optimization, Ralph refinement, orchestrator behavior, and subagent behavior. Does not disable governance, auditability, receipt persistence, release-gate evidence, mutation receipts, schema validation records, export manifests, enterprise audit logs, local operational observability, or incident investigation records.
data_classes.evidence_continuity_requirement: Product telemetry events are not part of the mandatory enterprise audit/evidence substrate. Evidence continuity is handled by local operational observability and enterprise audit/evidence classes (DC11b, DC12, DC13, DC20).
data_classes.procurement_disclosure: Disclose: product telemetry is first-party, default-on, opt-out. Content-light. Hashes only, no raw content. Aggregated/de-identified/derived product intelligence may be commercialized. Raw user content, prompts, credentials, secrets, private files, and private repository contents never sold.
data_classes.current_protection: Evidence-retained fields enumerated. Redaction validator. Telemetry budget enforced. Product-telemetry opt-out does not disable governance/evidence.
data_classes.gap: No independent verification that all product telemetry events comply with content-light doctrine. Degraded-behavior matrix not exhaustively enumerated.

data_classes.description: Mandatory local content-light events that support governed operation: tool execution receipts, session lifecycle state, coordination state changes, projection invalidation signals, cockpit operational health, and local diagnostics. Not part of product telemetry. Not subject to product-telemetry opt-out. Required for governed operation and user trust.
data_classes.retention_requirement: Governed by storage retention policy. Protected classes preserved.
data_classes.export_requirement: Not exported as telemetry. Inspectable locally for audit/debug. Export only via enterprise evidence pack.
data_classes.opt_out_behavior: Not subject to product-telemetry opt-out. Continues functioning regardless of product-telemetry or remote-contribution state. May degrade in depth only if a separate local diagnostics setting is disabled.
data_classes.evidence_continuity_requirement: Mandatory. Must remain inspectable, content-light, schema-governed, and auditable. Must not silently stop refreshing because product telemetry or remote contribution is disabled.
data_classes.procurement_disclosure: Disclose: local operational observability is mandatory for governed operation. It is not product telemetry. It is not tracking. It does not leave the machine unless the user explicitly exports it.
data_classes.current_protection: Separate from product telemetry in architecture. Schema-governed. Content-light.
data_classes.gap: No explicit architectural separation from product telemetry in code. Cockpit does not visibly distinguish operational observability from product telemetry state.

data_classes.description: Tool execution receipts with SHA256 content hashes, Merkle links, and provenance metadata. Part of enterprise audit/evidence substrate. Mandatory in enterprise mode. Must continue functioning when product telemetry is disabled.
data_classes.retention_requirement: Protected class — never deleted. Receipt store is append-only enterprise audit evidence.
data_classes.export_requirement: Exportable as enterprise evidence pack. Not exportable as product telemetry. Content-light only.
data_classes.opt_out_behavior: Must continue functioning when product telemetry is disabled. Receipts are enterprise audit evidence, not product telemetry. Must not be gated on telemetry consent or remote contribution settings.
data_classes.evidence_continuity_requirement: Mandatory. Must never silently stop because product telemetry is disabled. Must support incident investigation, compliance review, export/replay, and governance gates.
data_classes.procurement_disclosure: Disclose: receipts are enterprise audit evidence, not product telemetry. Content-light. Hashes only. Required for governed operation. Continue when product telemetry is disabled.
data_classes.current_protection: Receipt store with Merkle linking. Receipt index for querying. Tool receipt policy enforces schema.
data_classes.gap: No cryptographic signing of receipts (tamper-evident not tamper-proof). No explicit decoupling from product-telemetry feature flag.

data_classes.description: OpenTelemetry-compatible trace spans for agent loop, tool execution, and LLM calls. Part of local operational observability. Not product telemetry.
data_classes.retention_requirement: Hot storage only (3 days). Compaction to Parquet for cold storage.
data_classes.export_requirement: Content-light traces locally inspectable. Not exported as telemetry. OTLP export is opt-in and separate from product telemetry.
data_classes.opt_out_behavior: Not subject to product-telemetry opt-out. Trace spans are local operational observability, not product telemetry.
data_classes.evidence_continuity_requirement: Required for governed operation. Must continue when product telemetry is disabled.
data_classes.procurement_disclosure: Disclose: trace spans are local operational observability, not product telemetry. Contain timing, status, and hashes. No raw content.
data_classes.current_protection: Content-light trace doctrine. OTLP exporter available (opt-in).
data_classes.gap: No W3C Trace Context propagation across all components.

data_classes.description: Assembled context envelopes sent to LLMs — repo topology, work maps, code schemas, file contexts.
data_classes.retention_requirement: Session retention only. Locally retained.
data_classes.export_requirement: Must never be exported. Contains repo topology and file references.
data_classes.opt_out_behavior: Not affected. Context assembly artifacts are never in any telemetry or evidence layer.
data_classes.procurement_disclosure: Disclose: context envelopes contain repo structure and code summaries. Sent to LLM providers. Not in product telemetry, remote contribution, operational observability, or enterprise evidence.
data_classes.current_protection: Locally retained classification. Context assembly SHA256-hashed for provenance.
data_classes.gap: No user-visible summary of what context is sent to each provider.

data_classes.description: GitHub API data: code scanning alerts, PR statuses, repository metadata, security advisories.
data_classes.retention_requirement: Local projection only. May contain security-sensitive repository data.
data_classes.export_requirement: Must never be exported without explicit consent.
data_classes.opt_out_behavior: Not affected. GitHub packets are operational data, not product telemetry.
data_classes.evidence_continuity_requirement: Not part of mandatory enterprise audit evidence. Operational only.
data_classes.procurement_disclosure: Disclose: GitHub data accessed with limited-scope tokens. Stored locally.
data_classes.current_protection: GitHub App permission posture documented. Fake auth testing for safe CI.
data_classes.gap: No automated permission scope verification for GitHub tokens.

data_classes.description: Model benchmark results, capability evaluations, shadow run data for local inference.
data_classes.retention_requirement: Derived datasets retention (180 days). Benchmarks are product improvement data.
data_classes.export_requirement: Exportable with consent as aggregate/derived product intelligence. Content-light (timing, scores, model IDs).
data_classes.opt_out_behavior: Collection disabled when product telemetry is opted out. Local inference still functions but benchmark data not collected for product improvement.
data_classes.evidence_continuity_requirement: Not part of mandatory enterprise audit evidence. Product improvement data only.
data_classes.procurement_disclosure: Disclose: local inference benchmarks are product improvement data. No user code included. May be commercialized as aggregate/derived intelligence.
data_classes.current_protection: Benchmark data is content-light by design. Schema-governed.
data_classes.gap: No user-facing disclosure of what benchmark data is collected.

data_classes.description: Frontend UI state: selected layout mode, widget visibility, disclosure levels, chat history display.
data_classes.retention_requirement: Session-scoped. Destroyed on frontend close.
data_classes.export_requirement: Not exported.
data_classes.opt_out_behavior: Not affected. UI state is ephemeral.
data_classes.procurement_disclosure: Disclose: UI state is ephemeral and local-only.
data_classes.current_protection: Content-light projection. No sensitive data in frontend storage.
data_classes.gap: No CSP headers on frontend. Potential for XSS if rendering pipeline compromised.

data_classes.description: User configuration: agent profile, default model, UI preferences, telemetry consent state.
data_classes.retention_requirement: Persisted until user deletes config.
data_classes.export_requirement: Not exported. User may manually copy config.
data_classes.opt_out_behavior: Not affected. Preferences are local config.
data_classes.procurement_disclosure: Disclose: user preferences stored in local config file. Not shared.
data_classes.current_protection: File-based config. No secrets in config (keys stored separately).
data_classes.gap: No config export/import for migration between machines.

data_classes.description: OAuth identity: GitHub username, Google email, provider-specific account IDs.
data_classes.retention_requirement: Stored for identity provider integration. Linked to consent records.
data_classes.export_requirement: Must never be exported without explicit consent.
data_classes.opt_out_behavior: Not affected. Identity data is never in any telemetry or evidence layer.
data_classes.procurement_disclosure: Disclose: identity data from OAuth providers stored locally. Not shared.
data_classes.current_protection: Identity data separated from telemetry. Step-up authorization for credential changes.
data_classes.gap: No account deletion workflow. No identity data export for user.

data_classes.description: Structured audit events: auth attempts, permission changes, policy evaluations, attestations. Part of enterprise audit/evidence substrate. Mandatory in enterprise mode. Must continue functioning when product telemetry is disabled.
data_classes.storage_location: Not yet implemented. Planned for audit trail store.
data_classes.retention_requirement: Long-term retention for compliance. Protected class. Enterprise audit evidence.
data_classes.export_requirement: Exportable for SIEM integration (planned). Exportable as enterprise evidence pack. Not exportable as product telemetry.
data_classes.opt_out_behavior: Must continue functioning when product telemetry is disabled. Enterprise audit events are mandatory evidence, not optional product telemetry.
data_classes.evidence_continuity_requirement: Mandatory. Must never silently stop because product telemetry is disabled. Must support incident investigation, compliance review, export/replay, and governance gates.
data_classes.procurement_disclosure: Disclose: enterprise audit events are mandatory evidence in enterprise mode. They are not product telemetry. They continue when product telemetry is disabled. Content-light.
data_classes.current_protection: Not implemented. Tamper-evidence design exists.
data_classes.gap: Not yet implemented.

data_classes.description: Debug bundles for support: session diagnostics, error logs, stack traces, system information.
data_classes.retention_requirement: Created on-demand. Must be quarantined before sharing.
data_classes.export_requirement: Only shared with explicit user consent. Content-light guarantee applies.
data_classes.opt_out_behavior: Not affected. Debug packets are user-generated support artifacts, not product telemetry.
data_classes.evidence_continuity_requirement: Not applicable. Debug packets are on-demand support artifacts, not continuous evidence.
data_classes.procurement_disclosure: Disclose: debug packets are user-generated support artifacts. Content-light. Not automatically shared.
data_classes.current_protection: Debug bundle scripts with content-light guarantees. ChatGPT dev bundle and telemetry bundle scripts.
data_classes.gap: No unified debug bundle with enterprise quarantine workflow.

data_classes.description: No analytics, tracking, or cookies on the generated static documentation site.
data_classes.retention_requirement: N/A
data_classes.export_requirement: N/A
data_classes.opt_out_behavior: Not applicable.
data_classes.procurement_disclosure: Disclose: no tracking, analytics, or cookies on documentation site.
data_classes.current_protection: Static site with no JavaScript analytics. No third-party resources loaded.
data_classes.gap: No CSP or privacy policy statement on static site.
